## Welcome

I am a Master of Data Science student at the University of British Columbia with a background in Applied Mathematics.

My interests include machine learning, statistical modelling, data analysis, and applying quantitative methods to real-world problems.

My previous academic experience includes research in biomathematics, where I worked with mathematical models of biological systems, as well as applied machine learning experience through AI4Good.

This website highlights my academic work, research, projects, and experiences throughout the MDS program.
